major_required_fixes.issue: West large arches incorrectly glazed as full-height uniform curtainwall
major_required_fixes.evidence: Original A7 enlarged west elevation shows recessed rendered walls with separate upper windows and doors; central arch has visible staircase. All five wide arches are not full-width tall glass windows.
major_required_fixes.action: Remove continuous glazing and dense mullions; form recessed wall and discrete windows/doors from A3/A7, maintain central stair entrance.

major_required_fixes.issue: West diagonal stairs have solid triangular undersides infilling their open space
major_required_fixes.evidence: Original A7 and official panorama both show doors/open space beneath diagonal stair flights. Render white solid wedges obscure arches.
major_required_fixes.action: Model stair slab of finite thickness with steps and brick parapets; remove below-slab triangular infill.

major_required_fixes.issue: Central east entrance shown as single dark unframed arched panel
major_required_fixes.evidence: A7 depicts recessed entrance and separate double door, not uniform full-width unframed glazing.
major_required_fixes.action: Express entry recess and door divisions, avoiding unsupported curtainwall.

acceptable_major_features: Six four-quadrant curved canopies and front/rear slope orientation
historical_record_note: Retained record of superseded interim render defects. All three listed required corrections were visually verified resolved in the final seven-render audit. Original interim hashes remain unchanged for traceability.
